features: 💛 Super Soft Material: This shaggy area rug has a top layer of soft material with a sponge lower layer for a luxurious underfoot feel, making you feel like you're walking on a cloud. Imagine waking up in the morning and treating your feet to a plushy faux fur rug instead of a cold floor. Plus, the fluffy fur will make your feet feel comfy and cozy as you work away at your desk or couch.

💛 Modern Home Decor: Our fuzzy moroccan-inspired rug is a great way to enhance your modern room's decor, protect your hardwood floors, and bring warmth to your room. This abstract rug has a geometric design, giving it a unique look that will make it the centerpiece of any room. If you’re looking for a minimalist living room rug that still has an element of style, this is the one for you.

💛 How to Maintain: Recommended to do a quick shake of accent rug outside first, spot clean or hand wash in cold with carpet shampoo, and then air dry it. This modern trellis rug can also be maintained with a low-power vacuum cleaner to keep dust or dirt from damaging the geometric lattice rug, but not recommended for machine washing.

💛 Versatile Decorative Piece: Throw rugs come in a variety of colors and sizes to fit with the dimensions of your living room, bedroom, home office, kid's room, girl's room, boy's room, playroom, nursery, or college dorm. It works great under big furnitures, helps to anchor furnishings like bed and end tables or sofa and armchairs, and helps to keep shag bedroom rugs from slipping and shifting.

💛 Notice: Due to furry carpet comes vacuum sealed and laminated, it might not be as plush at first and normal to see some creases. But don't worry, please lay it flat, the high pile rug will recover fluffiness in 2 to 3 days.
